title: Aliens Are Preparing to Colonize Earth, UFO researcher Moshier claims
excerpt: Gary Moshier, a former US Department of War weapons contractor turned UFO researcher, has claimed that extraterrestrial beings are intimidating the US
content:
Gary Moshier, a former US Department of War weapons contractor turned UFO researcher, has claimed that extraterrestrial beings are intimidating the US military as part of a broader plan to colonize Earth. After conducting 12 years of independent research, Moshier argues that prominent military encounters and other unexplained phenomena are part of a coordinated campaign intended to demonstrate extraterrestrial technological superiority, Daily Mail reported.

Staged Encounters and Environmental Warnings

Moshier claims that UFOs intentionally interact with military personnel to demonstrate their technological superiority. He believes these encounters are staged to intimidate humanity and discourage resistance.

He points to the 2004 USS Nimitz “Tic Tac” incident, during which Navy pilots encountered an unidentified object that reportedly demonstrated extraordinary speed and maneuverability. Moshier interprets the object’s apparent response to fighter jet maneuvers as a deliberate demonstration of superior technology.

He also claims that UFOs have been documented entering classified Combat Air Patrol rendezvous points, locations where military pilots are expected to meet during operations. In his interpretation, these encounters suggest that extraterrestrial visitors possess detailed knowledge of military movements and capabilities.

Moshier further claims that aliens are monitoring humanity’s ability to preserve Earth. He cites a 1994 incident at the Ariel School in Ruwa, Zimbabwe, where 62 students reported seeing mysterious objects and humanoid figures. Several children claimed to have received telepathic messages, which Moshier interprets as warnings about humanity’s destruction of the environment.

Throughout the Cold War, former military personnel reported seeing UFOs over sensitive nuclear weapons facilities in both the United States and the Soviet Union. Several whistleblowers claimed that unidentified craft had the ability to activate and deactivate nuclear missiles at will.

Moshier links these accounts to his theory that extraterrestrials are attempting to demonstrate their dominance over humanity by showing that even the world’s most powerful weapons could be vulnerable to their technology.

The Ulterior Motive

Moshier argues that the alleged environmental warnings are ultimately self-serving. According to his theory, aliens want humanity to preserve the planet because they intend to settle on Earth themselves.

He believes that reported UFO encounters, alien abductions, crop circles and even cattle mutilations may be connected to a broader effort to influence human behavior and encourage environmental preservation.

Moshier further alleges that extraterrestrial visitors are creating hybrids that are part-human and part-alien. He claims these beings have developed to the point where they appear identical to ordinary humans and could live among the population undetected.

According to Moshier, the alleged hybrids differ from humans primarily in their neurological capabilities, although he has provided no verified physical evidence to support their existence.

The Daily Mail also referenced claims attributed to former Florida Congressman Matt Gaetz concerning alleged alien-human hybrids living undetected among the human population.

Moshier’s theories remain speculative, with no verified physical evidence establishing that extraterrestrials are visiting Earth, creating human hybrids or preparing to colonize the planet. The US government has maintained that it has found no verifiable evidence of extraterrestrial technology.
